headline: Labor unions in Ireland, which POLITICO calls Europe's tech capital, are growing fast amid layoffs that the outlet links to AI.
score_reason: Lowered by 1 from 5: only the headline is available and no other outlet was found carrying this story.
importance_line: Tech workers in Ireland and the large technology employers there are affected, but the size of the union growth and the link between the layoffs and AI are POLITICO's account and are not independently confirmed here.
summary: POLITICO Europe reports that labor unions in Ireland, which it calls Europe's tech capital, are booming amid layoffs it links to artificial intelligence.
notes: Headline only. politico.eu returned HTTP 403, and Google News searches on 17 Oct 2026 found no other outlet carrying this story. Related earlier Irish coverage exists but was not used as fact here (for example: Meta cutting up to 350 Irish jobs, BBC and The Journal, 20 May 2026; The Journal on 7 Mar 2026, 'Layoffs and the threat of AI: Why Irish tech workers are finally turning to unions'). If the main session wants one paragraph under rule 35, those are the places to look.
